title: Vancouver and Richmond Coastal Heritage and Wine Experience Tour
includes: Lu Lu Island Winery Admission Fee
Canada Place Cruise Terminal Pick-up Service
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Guests below the age of 19 will not be allowed for the wine tasting in Lu Lu Island Winery

Important Notice : From October 6 to December 31, 2026, "Britannia Shipyards" will only be open from Friday to Sunday. On days when the attraction is closed, the scheduled 30-minute visit will be reallocated to "Steveston Fisherman’s Wharf", allowing guests additional time to explore the area.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Vancouver beyond the ordinary on this unique full-day experience combining iconic city landmarks, coastal heritage, award-winning local wine, designer shopping, and authentic local culture. Journey through scenic False Creek and Cambie Bridge, visit the charming Steveston Fisherman's Wharf and historic Britannia Shipyards, enjoy a guided 3-pour wine tasting at Lu Lu Island Winery, and shop at McArthurGlen Designer Outlet. Complete your adventure with a visit to Vancouver's famous Earnest Ice Cream. Complimentary Cruise Terminal pick-up and airport drop-off for evening flights make this the perfect tour for cruise passengers and visitors seeking an unforgettable Vancouver experience.
